annotations.grafana.app/message: Installed by the Grafana Asserts Plugin

spec.description: This dashboard works with postgres_exporter for prometheus

targets.expr: group by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, short_version) (pg_static{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server"})

(time() -  max by(asserts_env, asserts_site, namespace, job) (pg_postmaster_start_time_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",job="$job", instance=~"$instance"})) / (60 * 60)

panels.title: General Counters, CPU, Memory and File Descriptor Stats

panels.description: Number of rows fetched by queries
panels.title: Current fetch data

panels.description: Number of rows inserted by queries
panels.title: Current insert data

panels.description: Number of rows updated by queries
panels.title: Current update data

panels.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent connections
panels.title: Max Connections

panels.description: Average user and system CPU time spent in seconds.
panels.title: Average CPU Usage

panels.description: Virtual and Resident memory size in bytes, averages over 5 min interval
panels.title: Average Memory Usage

targets.expr: sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server) (pg_settings_work_mem_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", instance=~"$instance"})

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site,server, datname, state)(pg_stat_activity_count{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", state="active", instance=~"$instance"} !=0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_xact_commit{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_fetched{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) != 0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_updated{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) != 0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_returned{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) != 0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_inserted{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) != 0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_deleted{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) != 0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname, state)(pg_stat_activity_count{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", state=~"idle|idle in transaction|idle in transaction (aborted)", instance=~"$instance"})

avg by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Total amount of data written to temporary files by queries in this database. All temporary files are counted, regardless of why the temporary file was created, and regardless of the log_temp_files setting.

targets.expr: sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_temp_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Temp File (Bytes)

targets.expr: sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname, mode)(pg_locks_count{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",datname=~"$db_name", server=~"$server", mode=~"$mode", instance=~"$instance"} != 0)

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_conflicts{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(namespace, asserts_env, asserts_site, server, datname)(rate(pg_stat_database_deadlocks{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env",asserts_site=~"$site",server="$server", datname=~"$db_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

targets.legendFormat: write_time - Total amount of time that has been spent in the portion of checkpoint processing where files are written to disk.
sync_time - Total amount of time that has been spent in the portion of checkpoint processing where files are synchronized to disk.

spec.title: PostgreSQL-KPI
